title: Performance verifier ignored the explicit versioned campaign authority

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 3.2.5 and 3.2.3 packages on Factorio 2.1.13 after MIR3-TERM-0024
source_observation.fact: All ten C32 performance lanes completed and passed, but Test-MIRRuntimePerformanceEvidence reopened the obsolete root C24 campaign instead of the explicit 3.2.5-C32 authority passed to Invoke-MIRPerformanceQualification.

reproducer.expected: Producer and verifier bind the same explicit versioned campaign authority.
reproducer.observed: The producer emitted passed C32 evidence, then the verifier failed with 'Runtime performance evidence does not bind a coherent governed target-era campaign.'

target_dispositions.reason: versioned campaign authority must remain consistent from evidence production through validation

regression_obligations: qualification forwards explicit CampaignPath to validation
validator resolves the supplied campaign relative to its declared repository
all published .5 archive and normalized-content identities remain unchanged
fixed_point_restart_scope: performance assurance proofs only; no package shadow restart

admission.reason: The correction aligns verifier authority routing with already-generated evidence and cannot affect package bytes.

closure.evidence: The exact 3.2.5 output must validate against C32, relocate byte-identically, and be followed by exact 2.0 plus hosted proof.
